dossier_meta.catalog_title: Tightness of linear capture time bound for planar graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is the bound $\mathrm{capt}_3(G) \leq 2n$ tight for planar graphs of order $n$? Does there exist a planar graph $G$ of order $n$ with $\mathrm{capt}(G) > n$?
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 5 establishes $\mathrm{capt}_3(G) \leq 2n$ for planar graphs of order $n$, improving the earlier $O(n^2)$ bound of Theorem 4. Whether this linear bound is tight is unknown; even finding a single planar graph with capture time exceeding $n$ remains open.
